descriptions.zh: 批量更新工作项字段，只支持工作项上下文字段以及自定义字段，不能更新工作项本身属性（描述，标题，状态等，这些字段选择更新工作项属性字段）。
descriptions.en: This operation performs a batch update of work item context fields and custom fields. It does not update core work item attributes, such as description, title, or status. To modify these attributes, use the dedicated operation for updating work item attributes.
